messages:
nina-partnerships: Heads up — customer PO 009122 is failing marketplace validation: portal reports MULTIPLE_VENDOR_IDS on a single PO. Customer attached a combined PO that references two vendor IDs.

ben-salesops: How did that happen? Customer said they reused an old template from last year. Can you paste the portal error?

nina-partnerships: Error snippet from portal: {"error":"MULTIPLE_VENDOR_IDS","details":"Found vendor ids [VND-998, VND-112] in order lines"}. Customer attached invoice lines referencing both Redwood direct (VND-998) and our reseller partner (VND-112).

lina-ops: Portal enforces a single vendor id per PO for entitlement provisioning. If lines reference different vendor ids, it rejects. We can either split into two POs or do manual provisioning.

vendor-ops: The reseller added their legacy vendor id to the quote for commission tracking. We can remove it and re-issue the PO if reseller agrees.

procure-annie: Customer deadline is tight. They want a single consolidated invoice. Splitting POs will break their AP process.

tom-legal: From a contract standpoint, both vendor ids map to related entities but invoicing paths differ. If we accept a single-PO with mixed vendor ids offline, we need signed acceptance from both vendors and an indemnity note.

finance-sam: Finance prefers keeping everything in marketplace for clean ledgering. Manual exception possible if legal + vendor confirm. We'll need a manual tag and reconciliation plan.

ben-salesops: Proposal: Ops to provision entitlement from the PO as-is (manual), finance to invoice Redwood direct, and we create a separate commission payout to reseller off-platform. Vendor-ops to confirm reseller consent.

vendor-ops: Reseller consented to commission payout off-platform. They asked we keep their vendor id for tracking in the quote PDF. They will sign a short consent note.

lina-ops: I can do manual entitlement provisioning once legal confirmation present. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MP-6210.

tom-legal: I'll draft a joint acceptance memo that both vendor entities sign that allows Redwood to accept the consolidated PO and handle commission separately. ETA 8 hrs.

finance-sam: Once memo is signed, finance will process the marketplace exception and tag ledger entry MANUAL-MP-009122. We'll reconcile when the partner commission payout is complete.

procure-annie: I'll hold payment until we have signed memo. Customer notified.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace feed audit flagged mixed-vendor-line in quote PDF for listing AH-RES-003 on 2025-03-11T14:09:02Z. See logs: /var/log/mfeed/vendorid-audit-20250311.log

nina-partnerships: Summary & owners: Legal (tom-legal) draft memo, Vendor (vendor-ops) get reseller consent signed, Ops (lina-ops) manual entitlement once signed, Finance (finance-sam) process exception, Procure (procure-annie) hold payment. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you acknowledge.
